notes.title: Card Cultivation will release the demo on March 24
notes.notes:
The demo of Card Cultivation will be permanently available for free play on the Steam store starting March 24 (next Monday). 

Compared to the previous test version, this demo includes several optimizations, such as a newly added tutorial, improved taskbar guidance, and the introduction of a currency system.

Please join our Discord channel if you have feedback about the game. If you enjoy Card Cultivation, don’t forget to add it to your wishlist!
